keyVerseDR: "And he called the twelve; and began to send them two and two..." (Mk 6:7)

level1.title: Jesus Sends His Friends
level1.story: Jesus sent His twelve Apostles out two by two. He told them to take only a walking stick. They preached and healed many sick people.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How did Jesus send His friends?
Who can you share Jesus with?
level1.prayer: Jesus, send me to share Your love. Amen.

level2.title: Sent Two by Two
level2.story: Jesus called the Twelve and began to send them out two by two, giving them power over unclean spirits. He told them to take nothing for the journey but a staff: no bread, no bag, no money. They were to wear sandals and not take two coats. If a place would not receive them, they were to shake the dust off their feet. They went out and preached that people should repent, cast out many devils, and anointed many sick with oil.
level2.keyLine: He called the twelve; and began to send them two and two.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus send them with so little?
actions: Do a service project with a friend
level2.prayer: Jesus, send me out with Your power. Amen.

activity.title: My mission this week
activity.intro: Jesus sends us too! Write 3 resolutions.
